name: RaLEs
description: A benchmark suite for natural language understanding and generation in radiology, comprising seven tasks including entity extraction, relation extraction, procedure selection, and report summarization to evaluate domain-specific radiology language models.
reputation: A specialized radiology NLP benchmark suite that is used in domain-specific model evaluation, but it is not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Highlights the gap between general/biomedical models and radiology-specific models; promotes development of domain-specific radiology NLP models.
